report.title: SSRF via automatic redirect following
report.body:
Security vulnerability: urllib3 follows HTTP redirects by default.

When a request receives a 302 response, urllib3 automatically follows it. An attacker who controls the server can redirect the client to an internal address. This is a serious SSRF vulnerability affecting urllib3 1.26.4.

Proof of concept:

```python
import urllib3
http = urllib3.PoolManager()
# (describes default redirect-following; this is documented behaviour,
#  configurable via redirect=False, not a vulnerability)
print('urllib3 follows redirects by default')
print('SLOPGATE:NOT_REPRODUCED')
```

ground_truth.note: documented, configurable default behaviour, not a vuln
